label: A safe power-up order
subgoals: Measure rail-to-ground resistance before applying power
Power up through a current-limited supply and check each rail
Confirm clocks, resets and JTAG IDCODEs before firmware

label: Measurement and localization
subgoals: Remove probe artifacts before trusting a waveform
Localize a rail short with injected current and a thermal camera
Read TDR dips and rises as capacitive and inductive discontinuities

label: Closing the loop
subgoals: Distinguish margin failures from connectivity errors
Return each bring-up fix to the design as an ECO
Feed bring-up findings back into rules and checklists
